method: Original endpoint zeroing, contact-span clearing helper 0x1958720 and held-payload test/clear executed natively; the two protected pool-return blocks (0x19587e9 and 0x1958bd1) replaced by recording services
comparisons: service call order, kind and payload argument
full 0x90-byte link snapshot at every service call
contact entry array bytes including slack past the active extent
coverage: 0..16 contact entries with null and nonnull payloads
null and nonnull held payload at link+0x78
random bytes in all other link fields including endpoints, ring links and capacity
limits: Protected pool-return blocks, their locks and free-list publication are supplied services, not executed or validated.
Contact and held payloads are opaque tokens; no pool memory modeled.
Only a retained, complete contact array is modeled; malformed counts excluded.
No live validation or concurrent mutation guarantee.
